fields.Name: T328 - Routines List Search and Status Filter Responds
fields.Description: Exercises the command center's card-list search + StatusFilter dropdown wiring (mj-page-search + mj-filter-popover over FilteredRoutines) and the filtered-vs-empty state — a custom card-list filter path, not AG-Grid column filtering.

InputDefinition.goal: In the Routines app, use the 'Search routines...' box in the toolbar to type a query, and open the 'Filters' popover (funnel icon) to pick a Status other than 'All statuses' (e.g. Active or Paused). Observe that the card list RESPONDS — the visible routine cards narrow to matches, the X-of-Y count badge in the header updates, OR a 'No Matching Routines' empty state appears when nothing matches. Then clear the filters. Success is the list reacting to search + status filtering (a valid empty-state counts). This works regardless of how many routines exist.

judgeValidationCriteria: Typing in the search box and/or choosing a Status in the Filters popover changes the visible cards, updates the count badge, or shows a 'No Matching Routines' empty state
Clearing the filters restores the unfiltered list
No error messages, blank screens, or crash pages
